description:
Keep or drop single photos in a photo submission: send keep or drop, one of them per call; to do both, make two calls. An id that is not a photo of this hire is left alone. This sorts photos only; it does not approve the work, refuse it or pay.
Use for: choosing the photos you want from a photo submission, before you download them with download_picked_photos.
Not for: approving the work and paying (pay_hire); refusing the whole submission (reject_submission).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: pick_photos({"hireId":"a3Fh8kQz1WpL0mNc","keep":["0f3c9a7e21b45d6e8a90","1b7d2e4f6a8c0e2a4b6c"]})
Repeat: A repeat may act again on the thing as it stands then. Read it first.
Errors: no_submission, no_photo_submission, not_in_review; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.
